title: From audit findings to a clean follow-up
body: A G&T co-op came to us after an audit produced multiple potential noncompliances in CIP-007 patch management and CIP-010 configuration baselines. We rebuilt both control processes around their existing tooling, drafted the mitigation plans, and operated the controls through completion. The follow-up spot check closed with zero findings.

title: Standing up CIP-013 ahead of procurement deadlines
body: An IPP with a lean procurement team needed a supply-chain risk program that wouldn't stall sourcing. We built a tiered vendor assessment workflow and a contract clause library mapped to R1, integrated into their existing purchasing system rather than alongside it.

title: INSM design before the enforcement date
body: A municipal utility engaged us to design CIP-015 monitoring before the September 2025 effective date. We produced the risk-based sensor placement rationale, retention procedures, and the documentation package tying coverage decisions to network risk — sized for the coming EACMS/PACS expansion.
